# Flutter documentation

> Flutter is an open-source framework for building beautiful, natively compiled, multi-platform applications from a single codebase.

This index provides a curated list of official documentation and resources covering the Flutter framework.

## Getting started

- [Flutter documentation website](https://docs.flutter.dev/index.md): The homepage for the Flutter documentation website.
- [Installation guide](https://docs.flutter.dev/install.md): The first step for any developer to set up their environment for Flutter development.
- [Introduction to declarative UI](https://docs.flutter.dev/flutter-for/declarative.md): The conceptual difference between Flutter's declarative style and the imperative style used by many other UI frameworks.
- [Flutter learning pathway](https://docs.flutter.dev/learn/pathway.md): Learn Dart fundamentals, then build three small Flutter apps.
- [Dart language tour](https://dart.dev/language): A comprehensive introduction to the Dart programming language, which is required for Flutter development.
- [Flutter Widget of the Week playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLjxrf2q8roU23XGwz3Km7sQZFTdB996iG): Short, engaging videos introducing individual widgets.

## Latest release

- [What's new in Flutter 3.50](https://flutter.dev/blog/whats-new-in-flutter-3-50): The official announcement for the 3.50 release of Flutter.
- [Announcing Dart 3.14](https://dart.dev/blog/announcing-dart-3-14): The official announcement for the 3.14 release of Dart.

## Learning resources

- [Flutter learning resources](https://docs.flutter.dev/reference/learning-resources): Browse codelabs, sample apps, workshops, and cookbook recipes by topic.
- [Flutter samples](https://github.com/flutter/samples): A repository of sample applications demonstrating Flutter best practices.

## Core concepts

- [Building user interfaces with Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui.md): A foundational explanation of how UIs are built with widgets.
- [Flutter widget index](https://docs.flutter.dev/reference/widgets): Look up widgets alphabetically and follow links to their API documentation.
- [Layouts in Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/layout.md): A guide to arranging widgets to create a user interface.
- [App architecture and resources](https://docs.flutter.dev/app-architecture/recommendations): Architecture best practices and recommendations for Flutter applications.
- [State management overview](https://docs.flutter.dev/data-and-backend/state-mgmt/options.md): The different approaches to managing state in a Flutter app.
- [BuildContext class](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/widgets/BuildContext-class.html): API reference for a widget's location in the widget tree.
- [Decoding Flutter video: BuildContext?!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rIaaH87z1-g): Video explaining what BuildContext is and why it shows up in so many widgets and builders.
- [Deep dive into Flutter's build modes](https://docs.flutter.dev/testing/build-modes.md): Understand the difference between debug, profile, and release modes.

## Building user interfaces

- [Basic widgets](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/widgets/basics): Learn about essential widgets like `Text`, `Image`, `Icon`, and `Row`.
- [Build a form with validation](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/forms/validation.md): Create a form and validate user input.
- [Retrieve the value of a text field](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/forms/retrieve-input.md): Get the text a user has entered.
- [Focus a text field](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/forms/focus.md): Programmatically focus a text field.
- [Basic list](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/lists/basic-list.md): Create a simple scrolling list.
- [Grid list](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/lists/grid-lists.md): Display items in a grid.
- [Horizontal list](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/lists/horizontal-list.md): Create a list that scrolls horizontally.

## Adding interactivity & navigation

- [Handle taps](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/gestures/handling-taps.md): Use `GestureDetector` to respond to a tap on a custom button.
- [Simple app state management](https://docs.flutter.dev/data-and-backend/state-mgmt/simple.md): Manage shared state with `ChangeNotifier` and the `provider` package.
- [Navigation and routing](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/navigation.md): An introduction to navigating between different screens in your app.
- [Navigate to a new screen and back](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/navigation/navigation-basics.md): The most basic navigation pattern.
- [Send data to a new screen](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/navigation/passing-data.md): Pass data to another screen.

## Animation

- [Implicit animations](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/animations/implicit-animations.md): Simple, animated widgets that animate a property change.
- [Explicit animations](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/animations/tutorial.md): Use AnimationController for more complex animations.
- [Animate a widget using a physics simulation](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/animation/physics-simulation.md): How to move a widget from a dragged point back to the center using a spring simulation.

## Advanced UI

- [Slivers, Demystified](https://flutter.dev/blog/slivers-demystified): An introduction to Slivers, covering SliverList, SliverGrid, SliverAppBar, and SliverPersistentHeader.
- [Creating custom scrolling effects with Slivers](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/layout/scrolling/slivers.md): Go beyond ListView to create custom scrollable layouts.
- [Painting and effect widgets](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/widgets/painting): Widgets that apply visual effects without changing layout, size, or position.
- [Adaptive and responsive design in Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/adaptive-responsive.md): Build UIs that look and feel great on any platform and any screen size.

## Data & backend

- [Choose a database for your Flutter app](https://docs.flutter.dev/data-and-backend/persistence/choose-a-database.md): Compare database options for Flutter apps, including Cloud Firestore (recommended default for cloud NoSQL and offline sync), Firebase SQL Connect (recommended default for cloud PostgreSQL with generated type-safe Dart SDKs), on-device SQLite (`sqflite` and `drift`), and key-value storage (`shared_preferences` and `flutter_secure_storage`).
- [Fetch data from the internet](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/networking/fetch-data.md): Make a basic HTTP request.
- [Networking with Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/data-and-backend/networking.md): Make HTTP requests and configure network permissions on Android and macOS.
- [Firebase for Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/data-and-backend/firebase.md): Connect your Flutter app to Firebase with `flutterfire configure`, authenticate users with `firebase_auth`, sync NoSQL data with `cloud_firestore`, query PostgreSQL with `firebase_data_connect`, and share Dart code with the experimental `firebase_functions` SDK.
- [Persist data with SQLite](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/persistence/sqlite.md): Learn the basics of local database storage.
- [Store key-value data on disk](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/persistence/key-value.md): For simple data storage using `shared_preferences`.

## Building AI-powered apps

- [Firebase AI Logic](https://firebase.google.com/docs/ai-logic.md.txt): Official documentation for Firebase AI Logic.
- [Firebase AI Logic package](https://pub.dev/packages/firebase_ai): The pub.dev package for Firebase AI Logic.
- [GenUI SDK for Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/ai/genui.md): Learn how to use the GenUI SDK for Flutter to build more interactive experiences in your apps.
- [Genkit Dart](https://genkit.dev/docs/dart/overview.md): An open-source, model-agnostic framework for building AI-powered apps in Dart and Flutter with type-safe schemas, flows, and built-in observability.
- [Genkit Flutter tutorial](https://genkit.dev/docs/app-frameworks/flutter.md): Connect a Flutter web UI to a Genkit backend and display structured results as they stream in.

## Testing & debugging

- [Testing Flutter apps](https://docs.flutter.dev/testing/overview.md): An overview of testing in Flutter, including unit, widget, and integration tests.
- [Measure performance with an integration test](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/testing/integration/profiling.md): Profile app performance during integration tests using `flutter drive --profile`.
- [An introduction to integration testing](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/testing/integration/introduction.md): Test the interaction between different parts of your app.
- [Mock dependencies in unit tests](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/testing/unit/mocking.md): Mock an HTTP client with Mockito to test success and error responses.
- [Finding widgets](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/testing/widget/finders.md): Find specific widget instances in a test environment.
- [Tapping, dragging, and entering text](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/testing/widget/tap-drag.md): Perform common user interactions in a widget test.
- [An introduction to widget testing](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/testing/widget/introduction.md): Use the `flutter_test` package to create, find, and verify widgets.
- [Debugging Flutter apps](https://docs.flutter.dev/testing/debugging.md): Techniques and tools for finding and fixing issues in your code.
- [Flutter DevTools](https://docs.flutter.dev/tools/devtools.md): An introduction to the suite of performance and debugging tools for Flutter and Dart.
- [Video: Dive into DevTools](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_EYk-E29edo): Video covering DevTools techniques for debugging and optimizing app performance.

## AI-assisted development

- [Get started with AI](https://docs.flutter.dev/ai/get-started.md): How to set up and use AI agent plugins for Flutter and Dart.
- [How Flutter AI tools work](https://docs.flutter.dev/ai/tools.md): Technical details on the skills, MCP server, and tools for AI coding assistants.
- [Package skills](https://dart.dev/ai/package-skills): Discover AI agent skills bundled in pub packages and author skills for your own packages.
- [Supercharge your Dart & Flutter development experience with the Dart and Flutter MCP server](https://flutter.dev/blog/supercharge-your-dart-flutter-development-experience-with-the-dart-mcp-server): A blog post explaining the benefits of the MCP server.
- [Gemini in Android Studio now speaks fluent Flutter](https://flutter.dev/blog/gemini-in-android-studio-now-speaks-fluent-flutter): A blog post about Gemini's Flutter capabilities in Android Studio.

## Performance & optimization

- [Performance best practices](https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/best-practices.md): A comprehensive guide to writing performant Flutter code.
- [Flutter performance profiling](https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/ui-performance.md): Use DevTools to diagnose performance issues.
- [Concurrency and isolates](https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/isolates.md): Run intensive tasks in the background to avoid blocking the UI.
- [Use the memory view in DevTools](https://docs.flutter.dev/tools/devtools/memory.md): Inspect memory allocation and detect memory issues.
- [Measuring your app's size](https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/app-size.md): Learn how to reduce your app's bundle size.
- [Deferred components](https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/deferred-components.md): Allow parts of your app to be downloaded on demand to improve initial load time.

## Platform integration

- [Native interoperability overview](https://docs.flutter.dev/interop.md): Compare and choose the right approach for calling native C, C++, Objective-C, Swift, Java, and Kotlin code from Flutter.
- [Multiplatform native interop with Pigeon](https://docs.flutter.dev/interop/pigeon.md): Generate type-safe, idiomatic multiplatform bindings between Dart and native host languages using `package:pigeon`.
- [C and Objective-C interop with FFIgen](https://docs.flutter.dev/interop/ffigen.md): Generate Dart FFI bindings from C and Objective-C header files using `package:ffigen`.
- [Java and Kotlin interop with JNIgen](https://docs.flutter.dev/interop/jnigen.md): Generate Dart bindings for Android Java and Kotlin APIs using `package:jnigen`.
- [Native memory with dart:ffi](https://docs.flutter.dev/interop/dart-ffi.md): Allocate and free native memory and convert between Dart and C strings.
- [Bind native code with build hooks](https://docs.flutter.dev/interop/bind-native-code.md): Compile and bundle native code assets automatically in Dart and Flutter packages using `hook/build.dart`.
- [Writing custom platform-specific code](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/platform-channels.md): Communicate with native code using platform channels.
- [Hosting native Android views in your Flutter app with Platform Views](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/android/platform-views.md): Embed native Android views in a Flutter app using platform views.
- [Host native iOS views in your Flutter app with platform views](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/ios/platform-views.md): Embed native iOS views in a Flutter app using platform views.

## Multiplatform development

- [Set up Android development](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/android/setup.md): Configure the Android toolchain and run apps on a device or emulator.
- [Build and release for Android](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/android.md): A guide to packaging and deploying your Flutter app to the Google Play Store.
- [Set up iOS development](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/ios/setup.md): Configure Xcode and run apps on a device or simulator.
- [Build and release for iOS](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/ios.md): A guide to packaging and deploying your Flutter app to the Apple App Store.
- [Building a web application with Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/web/building.md): Configure, run, and build a web application using Flutter.
- [Adding Flutter to any web application](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/web/embedding-flutter-web.md): Embed Flutter views in an existing web app or use Flutter for the full page.
- [Support for WebAssembly (Wasm)](https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/web/wasm.md): Compile Flutter web apps to WebAssembly.
- [Build and release for Windows](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/windows.md): A guide to packaging and deploying your Flutter app to Windows.
- [Set up Windows flavors](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/flavors-windows.md): Configure build flavors for Windows desktop apps.
- [Build and release for macOS](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/macos.md): A guide to packaging and deploying your Flutter app to macOS.
- [Build and release for Linux](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/linux.md): A guide to packaging and deploying your Flutter app to Linux.
- [Set up Linux flavors](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/flavors-linux.md): Configure build flavors for Linux desktop apps.

## Practical development concerns

- [Using packages](https://docs.flutter.dev/packages-and-plugins/using-packages.md): How to add new functionality to your app with packages.
- [Monetization with the google_mobile_ads package](https://pub.dev/packages/google_mobile_ads): The official plugin for displaying Google Mobile Ads.
- [Security best practices](https://docs.flutter.dev/security.md): An overview of security considerations for Flutter apps.
- [Code obfuscation](https://docs.flutter.dev/deployment/obfuscate.md): Hide function and class names in compiled Dart code to make it harder to reverse engineer.

## Accessibility & internationalization

- [Accessibility in Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/accessibility.md): A guide to making your Flutter app accessible to all users.
- [Internationalizing Flutter apps](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/internationalization.md): How to prepare your app for a global audience.

## Design & UX

- [Organize a theme](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/design/themes.md): Learn how to use `ThemeData` for a consistent design.
- [Cupertino (iOS-style) widgets](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/widgets/cupertino): Build apps that look and feel native on iOS.
- [Material widgets](https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/widgets/material): A comprehensive list of Material Design widgets.
- [Migrate to standalone material_ui and cupertino_ui packages](https://docs.flutter.dev/release/breaking-changes/material-ui-and-cupertino-ui.md): Migrate from the in-framework Material and Cupertino libraries to the standalone `package:material_ui` and `package:cupertino_ui` packages.
- [Use a custom font](https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/design/fonts.md): Implement custom typography in your app.

## Advanced topics & internals

- [Architectural overview](https://docs.flutter.dev/resources/architectural-overview.md): A high-level view of Flutter's architecture.
- [Impeller rendering engine](https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/impeller.md): Learn about Flutter's Impeller rendering engine and the platforms it supports.
- [Asynchronous programming in Dart](https://dart.dev/language/async): Work with futures and streams using `async`, `await`, and `await for`.
- [Dart isolates for concurrency](https://dart.dev/language/isolates): Understand how to use isolates for parallel processing.
